_readme: Planned items that are NOT in the game yet, with the prices worked out on 2026-09-20 (see docs/FUTURE_PRICES.md for the reasoning). The game does not read this file. To add one, copy its entries into economy.json (a projectile needs a `shop.items` entry AND a `projectiles.<id>` entry, a buff only a `shop.items` entry), add its picture, and check 'py tools/economy_report.py'. Names, images and descriptions are placeholders. Basis: 75% hit rate, one use of a buff = one stack of its own tier, buff price = 60% of the return, +-25% ranges, hit value = 1.6 x the average price per piece. (The common 1.1x coin bonus was added to the game as Snowy Cube on 2026-09-20, so it is no longer listed here.) The rare 20% save was added as Mints on 2026-09-20. The legendary Sure Shot (a guaranteed hit) was built as the Diamond Cross on 2026-09-20 (branch diamond-cross, not pushed yet).

projectiles._note: EPIC STANDARD: the ordinary epic projectile (the Grenade is the epic heavy hitter). Average stack 3000, hit value 960 (the epic rarity default).
LEGENDARY STANDARD. Average stack 15000, hit value 4800 (the legendary rarity default).
LEGENDARY HEAVY HITTER: a stack of 1-3, price per piece 2.5x the standard, hit value 2.5x (12000). Average stack 15000.

buffs._note: EPIC save chance 50% (was 30%): save chances stack as independent rolls (10 / 20 / 50 -> 64% together). Price = 60% of half a 3,000 stack.
buffs.name: TBD

buffs._note: LEGENDARY FREE THROW (replaces the legendary 50% save): a one-time charge, no timer - the NEXT throw that would use up a bought projectile does not (never spent on the snowball; the save-chance roll comes first and the charge is only spent if that fails; several charges queue one per throw). NEEDS A NEW MECHANIC (effect 'freeThrow'). Worth one piece of the best projectile (3,000 standard, 7,500 heavy hitter): priced at one standard piece.
buffs.name: TBD

price_ladder_summary.face_multiplier: x2.5 fits a legendary standard projectile; with a lower-tier projectile it pays little (a buff for the best projectile). If it should depend on the projectile: 2.5 x the buff's price / the hit value, kept between x2 and x20.
price_ladder_summary.save_chance_ladder: 10% common (Water Bottle), 20% rare (Mints), 50% epic (planned); they stack as independent rolls, 64% together, capped at 90%. Legendary = a one-time free throw instead of a percentage.
price_ladder_summary.stacking: Save chances: independent rolls, cap 90%. Coin multipliers and offset slow-downs multiply, no cap.
